The fence is drawn in pure front elevation. The horizontal rails and vertical pickets are rendered flat facing south with left-to-right shading and dark outline rows; neither the posts nor the horizontal rails display a foreshortened top surface (at most 0-1px edge lines).

The fence is drawn in pure front elevation. The horizontal rails are shown from the side/front (upper rail rows 2-4 with a 1px border/highlight; lower rail rows 10-11 at only 2px total height) without any foreshortened top face showing the depth of the beams or fence posts.
